about_the_game:
This is the demo version of AM. While it’s not required to enjoy the full game, it does contain exclusive story elements you won’t find anywhere else. We recommend playing the demo before diving into the full experience.

Battle demons with the power of your Jesus-charged flashlight! This massive, 40+ minute demo is the first chapter of AM, featuring a vast world to explore, terrifying encounters, and plenty of jaw-dropping surprises. Your mission? Survive the Rapture—from the driver’s seat of your beat-up junker.

DEMO FEATURES CONTENT UNIQUE FROM THE FULL GAME!

  • Miles of roads to explore in an oppressive game world.

  • High speed gameplay with intense and terrifying encounters.

  • An interactive radio with over an hour of content to keep you company.

  • A massive demo with over 40 mintues of gameplay.

  • Progress is saved, play the demo at your own pace.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of gore and features moments some players may find disturbing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1080 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2080 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: AM is a high-speed horror game that keeps you on the edge of your seat—and your foot on the gas—as you race to leave the nightmares of an abandoned world in your rearview.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
